missing_information_behavior: If thyroid diagnosis, medication or iodine exposure is unclear, retain professional-review override and do not recommend iodine supplementation.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer iodine deficiency from thyroid symptoms or diagnosis.
Do not recommend kelp/seaweed iodine products with highly variable iodine content without clinician review.
Do not modify levothyroxine, antithyroid therapy or prescribed iodine treatment.
professional_escalation_conditions: Hashimoto thyroiditis, Graves disease, nodules, thyroid cancer or thyroid surgery.
Pregnancy/lactation, amiodarone or lithium use, or high-dose iodine exposure.
population_and_context: Users with known thyroid disease or thyroid medication exposure being assessed for iodine intake; both deficiency and excess can affect thyroid function.
dose_constraints: No individualized dose from this rule. Evaluate total iodine from diet, iodized salt, seaweed and supplements against life-stage reference values.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Iodine fact sheet describes the U-shaped risk of inadequate and excessive iodine and relevant drug interactions; thyroid-specific care requires endocrinology guidance. This justification remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
